content.title: Pelicans vs. Kings: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (4/3/26)
content.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (25–52) face the Sacramento Kings (20–57) tonight at Golden 1 Center in a matchup between two lottery-bound teams. The Pelicans have lost six straight after falling to the Portland Trail Blazers last night, 118–106, as they continue to struggle on offense. New Orleans is averaging just 105.5 PPG over their last four games. In Thursday’s matchup against the Blazers, the Pelicans went into the half up by five, but were shut down by Portland in the third quarter, limited to just 16 points, undone by turnovers. Jeremiah Fears led with 21 points and Trey Murphy III added 19, but went just 1-of-6 from deep. Zion Williamson scored 15 points, taking just seven shots. while rookie Derik Queen added 12 points, seven assists, and six rebounds. The Kings, meanwhile, are coming off a surprising 123–115 win to the Toronto Raptors on Wednesday, as DeMar DeRozan pulled off a vintage performance, scoring 28 points — including 14 in the fourth quarter. Precious Achiuwa also had one of his best games of the season, scoring 28 points and grabbing 19 rebounds, making the most of quality minutes on the floor. The Pelicans have the edge here with more depth, but they seem disinterested on the floor, and the Kings could take this one with a strong night from DeRozan.
